title: PR Review Intermediate
description: Shape consumed by render.mjs to produce the HTML report. Claude (the review-pr skill) emits this after gathering and judging comments.

body.description: First paragraph/excerpt of PR body. Empty string if none.

repo_root.description: Absolute path to local repo root, used to build vscode://file/ deep links. Optional; if absent links degrade to plain text.

resolved_hidden_count.description: Number of resolved threads suppressed (default mode). Always 0 when --all is in effect.

include_resolved.description: Whether --all was used. If true, resolved comments are present in `comments`.

comments.description: Inline comments, ordered by global number (#1, #2, …).

number.description: Per-call global number, shown in UI. NOT stable across calls.

database_id.description: GitHub-stable integer ID (PullRequestReviewComment.databaseId). Use this to identify a comment across re-runs.

thread_id.description: GraphQL node ID of the parent reviewThread. Stable across re-runs.

url.description: Direct GitHub link to the comment (PullRequestReviewComment.url).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601. Used by render.mjs to detect edits across calls.

last_edited_at.description: ISO 8601 of last body edit, or null if never edited.

is_outdated.description: True if the diff line is outdated relative to current HEAD.

resolved_by.description: Login of user who resolved the thread, or null if unresolved.

body.description: Full comment body. Empty string if no body.

summary.description: <=15 자 한국어 요약. Used in dashboard table.

database_id.description: GitHub-stable ID for the reply comment. Used to detect newly-added replies across re-runs.

related.description: Related code locations checked while judging validity (🔗 field).

diff_hunk.description: Original diff hunk for context. Empty string if not fetched.

processing_order.description: Suggested order: Valid(수정) → Valid(이슈 생성) → Partial → Unclear → Invalid, each group by number.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Claude emitted the JSON.
